notes.title: ⚔️ Saber Survivors – Major Update is Live for Summer Sale 2025! 🛡️🔥
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="oWbXu_jPHBc;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hey Deflectors!

We’ve been cooking up something big — and it’s finally here. Just in time for the Steam Summer Sale 2025, our Major Update for Saber Survivors is live and packed with brand-new content, features, and improvements based on your amazing feedback. Here’s what’s new:


Meet the New Warriors!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375883/c7defc33067ac75ddfe9d2f5087c3d5790b9aa16.gif"]

Tired of the same ol’ crew? Say hello to New Warriors, each bringing their own playstyle, flair, and strategic edge. Whether you’re a Tanker or a Saber master — we’ve got someone for you.


Meta Progression Has Arrived!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375883/d72fa0a809dcb021c9bc32d2d4a08d51633aa144.png"]

You asked, we listened.
We’ve added a full-fledged Meta Progression system — unlock powerful upgrades that carry across runs, so you feel stronger, faster, and smarter every time you deflect into battle.


New Skills, New Combos, New Mayhem
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375883/00ede609ef6590a2968dcba4eb0574882806a93b.gif"]

More toys for your deflection arsenal!
We’ve added a wave of new skills to discover and combine. Experiment with builds, unleash synergy-driven chaos, and craft your ultimate survivor loadout.


New Biome Unlocked: Welcome to the Dreadstar
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375883/f274d7ab7fc81dc4d1fa8df13026cca7d363c938.gif"]

Burnt out in the desert? 

Journey into Dreadstar — a mysterious, hostile biome filled with troopers threats, eerie atmosphere, and unique challenges. It’s darker. It’s deadlier. It’s deflect-or-die.



💬 We’d Love Your Feedback! 

Try out the new update and let us know what you think! Have ideas for new features or balance changes? Drop your feedback in the comments below.  

Happy deflecting! 🗡️✨
